ns2:section.sectionText: 3 hours. Field expedition to Costa Rica over spring break (approx. 9 days), and weekly seminar. This course uses Costa Rica as a case study to examine issues of sustainability and the environment. Topics include rainforest ecology, land-use issues, sustainable agriculture, global versus local economies, and geologic features of the landscape, including volcanoes and rivers. Estimated program fee of $3,309; scholarships from college and dept. available. Primarily for ESES majors and Unit One Living Learning Community Students but others are encouraged to apply in case spots remain available. Enrollment is through LAS Abroad. Apply at: ESE 389 Application Applications submitted prior to October 16 will be given priority.
